page: Google Cloud Platform c4n-highmem-24-lssd is a memory-optimized server instance belonging to the c4n family. It features 24 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 CPU architecture, paired with 186.0 GB of system memory. This configuration provides a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 7.75 GB per core, designed to support memory-intensive workloads without the overhead of unneeded compute resources.

This instance type does not include GPU accelerators, having a GPU count of zero. While the instance family name suggests local solid-state drive capabilities, the specific configuration reports local storage size as none, meaning primary storage must be provisioned via network-attached block storage. There are no complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this instance.

The c4n-highmem-24-lssd is structured for workloads requiring substantial memory capacity per core, such as medium-sized databases, in-memory caching layers, and data-intensive enterprise applications. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated allocation of 24 vCPUs combined with 186.0 GB of RAM offers a dense resource profile that minimizes compute waste for memory-bound tasks, though the lack of bundled local storage requires external storage planning.
